name: Pumpkin Basque Cheesecake
recipeIngredient: 1 3/4 c. (373 g) packed light brown sugar

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. In a 9″ springform pan, overlap 2 pieces of parchment, leaving a 2″ overhang on all sides.

In the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat cream cheese and brown sugar on medium speed until creamy and no lumps remain, about 2 minutes. Add pumpkin and beat until combined. Add eggs and beat until incorporated, 1 minute. Scrape down bowl, then add egg yolks and vanilla, beating until incorporated, 1 minute more. Add flour, pumpkin pie spice, and salt and beat on medium-low speed until just combined. Add cream and beat, scraping bottom and sides of bowl as needed, until incorporated, about 2 minutes.
Place prepared pan on a baking sheet. Pour batter into pan; it will be very full.
Bake cheesecake until top is very dark and puffed, edges are slightly set, and center is still quite jiggly, 60 to 70 minutes.
Let cool at room temperature for 30 minutes, then refrigerate until chilled, at least 4 hours and up to overnight.
When ready to serve, remove sides of pan and slice cake. Serve cold or at room temperature with caramel alongside.
